name: wellness-wheel
label: Wellness wheel
description: The eight dimensions of wellness as a wheel: hover, tap or arrow-key a segment to see how we help in that dimension. Always eight segments in this order: Emotional, Occupational, Intellectual, Environmental, Financial, Social, Physical, Spiritual.

dimensions.name: Emotional
dimensions.step1: Daily connection and a co-equal relationship with peers
dimensions.step2: Care referrals, and our continued daily presence
dimensions.summary: Wellbeing starts with someone who shows up. Our peers are there every day, as equals.

dimensions.name: Occupational
dimensions.step1: Reliable transportation (bus passes, bike locks) and professional clothing
dimensions.step2: Referrals for job placement programs, and résumé assistance
dimensions.summary: Work and purpose depend on being able to get there, and to show up as yourself.

dimensions.name: Intellectual
dimensions.step1: Art, poetry and movie workshops, and supplies
dimensions.step2: Exploration: referrals and information for classes, groups and events
dimensions.step3: Program enrollments for education and more, with ongoing goal-setting and support
dimensions.summary: Curiosity doesn't wait for housing. Learning is part of how people rebuild.

dimensions.name: Environmental
dimensions.step1: Park cleanup, sleeping bags or blankets, clothing
dimensions.step2: Laundry vouchers, plus referrals and information for shelters and free, friendly public spaces with bathrooms, showers and storage
dimensions.summary: The spaces people live in, and move through, shape everything else.

dimensions.name: Financial
dimensions.step2: Enrollment and advocacy for Aid to the Needy Disabled (AND), SSI and SSDI
dimensions.step3: Long-term goal setting and individualized planning
dimensions.summary: Money is a barrier at every step. We remove it first, then help people build a way forward.

dimensions.name: Social
dimensions.step2: Continued daily interaction, deepening connection, and prosocial events
dimensions.summary: Belonging is basic. It starts with conversation and grows into community.

dimensions.name: Physical
dimensions.step1: Nutritious food and water, hygiene supplies, basic wound care, safe-use and harm reduction supplies, and safer-sex supplies
dimensions.step2: Food bank information, care referrals, and SNAP and Medicaid enrollment
dimensions.summary: Food, water, first aid and harm reduction come first, wherever someone is.

dimensions.name: Spiritual
dimensions.step1: Outreach by the faith groups that join our events
dimensions.step2: Conversation, and referrals to programs and groups that fit each person
dimensions.summary: Meaning looks different for everyone. We make room for whatever it is for you.

ai.purpose: Shows the eight dimensions of wellness and the three steps of support in each.
ai.avoid: Changing the number or order of dimensions.
